name: Nether Wing
summary: A Nether Wing is a demon’s wing sought by Reclaimers Inc. in Desolace. Kreldig Ungor needs ten for a mage’s experiments, alongside other dangerous reagents.

sections.title: A Demon's Wing
sections.body: Nether Maidens, Nether Sorceresses, and Nether Sisters in Desolace bear the wings Kreldig Ungor seeks. He asks for ten as part of a collection of reagents for a mage’s experiments. The work also calls for Felhound Brains and vials of Doomwarder Blood, making this a perilous gathering.

faq.answer: Kreldig Ungor in Desolace seeks ten Nether Wings for a mage’s experiments.
Nether Wings come from Nether Maidens, Nether Sorceresses, and Nether Sisters in Desolace.

faq.q: Why does Kreldig Ungor need them?
faq.answer: Kreldig Ungor gathers Nether Wings as reagents for a mage’s experiments.
The collection also requires Felhound Brains and vials of Doomwarder Blood.
